resources.string: Open About phone. Tap Build number seven times. On Xiaomi, tap OS version instead. Enter your screen lock if asked.

Connect to Wi-Fi. You will enter Android’s six-digit code through Sukut’s notification. Keep the pairing-code window open, pull down notifications, expand Sukut’s notification, then tap Enter pairing code and send the code.
Tap below and allow notifications. In Android settings, enable Wireless debugging and choose Pair device with pairing code. Follow step 2; Sukut returns here when ready.
In Developer options, turn on USB debugging.
Use a USB data cable. Unlock the phone and approve Allow USB debugging for your computer.
Real phone example. Sensitive details are blurred. Your phone may look slightly different.
